diagram:
flowchart TD
  TRIG["▶ On-demand / batch (watchlist top 3)"] --> RUN["🤖 Same research via DeepSeek"]
  RUN --> LABEL["🏷️ Write signals\nagent_label = 'deepseek'"]
  LABEL --> COMPARE["⚖️ Compare vs primary (Claude/Groq)"]
  COMPARE --> DECIDE["📊 Which LLM scores better?\n(before scaling)"]

TRIG.label: On-demand / batch
TRIG.description: Runs a single symbol (body.symbol) or, with no symbol, batches the top 3 research-enabled watchlist names. Not a scheduled cron.
TRIG.addReason: A/B is exploratory — run to sample comparison data.
TRIG.changeReason: Batch mode fixed: was ordering by a non-existent added_at column (0 rows → 400); now filters research_enabled + orders by created_at.

RUN.label: Research via DeepSeek
RUN.description: Runs the same research/scoring pipeline but with the DeepSeek LLM, to measure signal quality vs the primary model.
RUN.addReason: Cheap A/B: is DeepSeek good enough to scale on?

LABEL.label: agent_label = deepseek
LABEL.description: Writes signals tagged agent_label='deepseek' into agent_signals so they can be compared side-by-side with the primary agent's signals.
LABEL.addReason: Labeled rows enable the comparison UI.

COMPARE.label: Compare vs primary
COMPARE.description: The AgentComparisonCard shows DeepSeek vs primary signals and, once trades close, which model's calls performed better.
COMPARE.addReason: Evidence before committing to a cheaper model.

DECIDE.label: Which LLM wins
DECIDE.description: Determines whether DeepSeek's cheaper scoring matches the primary before scaling it up. Advisory — does not change the live model automatically.
